scientific_integrity: All numerical assertions are backed by a self-contained mathematical proof; finite verifier runs are reported only as corroboration. Originality review is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Primary coverage includes ordinary cycles (2018) and the scalar zero-forcing number of cyclic powers (2026); novelty is restricted to the all-set characterization, full polynomial and minimum-set classification. A possibly equivalent formula under consecutive-circulant terminology is a residual risk; no independent validation has been performed.
title: First-force rigidity and zero-forcing polynomials of powers of cycles
